modmenu.descriptionTranslation.litematic: Schematic holograms, area selection, verification, material lists, easy place and paste. Reads and writes .litematic files.
litematicaplus.screen.title: Litematica Plus
litematicaplus.error.session_read_only: Session file is from a newer version. Changes are not saved.
litematicaplus.error.tool_item: Unknown item. Enter an item ID such as minecraft:stick.
litematicaplus.overview.empty_hint: Pick a file to see it as a hologram where you stand.
litematicaplus.overview.footer: Tool: %s. Ctrl+Scroll switches mode, Alt+Scroll nudges, Alt+Click uses your position.
litematicaplus.schematics.empty_hint: Put .litematic, .schem or .nbt files into the schematics folder, then press Refresh.
litematicaplus.schematics.pick_hint: Select a file to see its size, block count and author.
litematicaplus.schematics.unreadable: This file could not be read: %s
litematicaplus.schematics.author: Author
litematicaplus.placements.empty_hint: A placement is a schematic positioned in the world. Load a file to create the first one.
litematicaplus.placements.none_selected_: Pick one from the list to move, rotate or paste it.
litematicaplus.placements.name: Placement name
litematicaplus.placement.failed: The schematic could not be loaded: %s. Check the file, then press Reload.
litematicaplus.area.empty_hint: Add a box, then set its two corners.
litematicaplus.area.tool_hint: Hold %s in Area mode: left click sets corner 1, right click sets corner 2. Or add a box on the left.
litematicaplus.area.error_nothing: Nothing to save. Set both corners of a box and enter a file name.
litematicaplus.area.error_exists: %s already exists. Press Replace to overwrite it.
litematicaplus.area.error_capture: The area could not be read: %s
litematicaplus.area.error_write: The file was not written: %s. Check free space and folder permissions.
litematicaplus.materials.sort.name: name
litematicaplus.materials.empty_hint: Every block of this placement is already in place. Turn off Hide done to see the full list.
litematicaplus.materials.no_placement_hi: The material list counts what a placement still needs. Load a schematic to start.
litematicaplus.verifier.empty_hint: Loaded chunks match the schematic for the enabled categories.
litematicaplus.verifier.no_placement_hin: The verifier compares the world with a placement. Load a schematic to start.
litematicaplus.verifier.unknown: %s blocks are in unloaded chunks and were not checked
litematicaplus.settings.summary: Changes are saved when you leave
litematicaplus.hud.title: LITEMATICA+
litematicaplus.hud.render_failed: Rendering stopped after an error. See the log.
litematicaplus.message.no_placement: No placement selected. Open the menu and load a schematic.
litematicaplus.message.no_selection: No area selected. Set two corners first.
litematicaplus.message.placement_locked: Placement is locked. Unlock it in the Placements tab.
litematicaplus.message.placement_restric: That block does not belong here. Turn off Placement guard to place it anyway.
litematicaplus.message.easy_place_orient: Turn to face the way the block points, then try again
litematicaplus.message.creative_required: Paste and Delete need creative mode
litematicaplus.message.paste_busy: Another paste is running. Right click with the tool to cancel it.
litematicaplus.message.paste_failed: Paste stopped because of an error. See the log for details.
litematicaplus.area.saved_partial: Saved %1$s blocks to %2$s, but %3$s chunks were not loaded and are missing. Move closer and save again.
litematicaplus.error.not_schematic: This is not a supported schematic file
litematicaplus.error.too_large: The schematic is too large to load
litematicaplus.error.unreadable: The file could not be read
litematicaplus.error.out_of_memory: Not enough memory for this schematic
litematicaplus.error.too_many_states: The schematic uses too many different block states
litematicaplus.error.selection_too_large: The selection is too large to save
litematicaplus.message.unknown_blocks: %1$s: %2$s block types are unknown to this game version and were left out
litematicaplus.message.newer_schematic: %s was saved by a newer game version and may look different
litematicaplus.message.confirm_delete: Click again to delete %1$s boxes (%2$s blocks)
litematicaplus.message.delete_too_large: The selection has %1$s blocks; the limit for Delete is %2$s
litematicaplus.message.no_command_permis: The server does not let you use %s
litematicaplus.message.paste_no_data: Container contents are not pasted through commands
litematicaplus.message.paste_slow: You are not an operator, so commands are sent slowly to avoid a spam kick
litematicaplus.state.loading_hint: The list appears when loading finishes.
litematicaplus.state.hidden_hint: Turn on Shown in Placements to check it.
key.litematicaplus.take_materials: Take materials from the open container
litematicaplus.hotkeys.tip: Click, then press a key or a mouse button other than the left one. Esc clears the binding, a left click cancels.
litematicaplus.message.easy_place_restri: Easy place is on: blocks go only where the schematic wants them. Aim at a ghost block.
litematicaplus.message.observer_wait: The observer waits for the block it watches
litematicaplus.message.clearing: Breaking %s to place the right block
litematicaplus.message.clear_timeout: The block in the way could not be broken
litematicaplus.message.guard_outside: Excavation guard: this block is outside the schematic
litematicaplus.message.guard_correct: Excavation guard: this block is already correct
litematicaplus.option.easy_place_hold.ti: Keep the use button held and sweep over ghost blocks. When off, one press places one block.
Ticks between placements. Balanced 2, Safe 4 for strict anti-cheats, Fast 1, Custom uses the delay next to it.
litematicaplus.option.easy_place_delay.t: Used when the pace is Custom.
Adds 0 or 1 tick at random between placements so the rhythm is less mechanical.
litematicaplus.option.easy_place_fake_ro: Sends the needed look direction to the server, so stairs, pistons and observers face the way the schematic wants while your camera stays still.
litematicaplus.option.easy_place_lead.ti: How many ticks before the click the turn is sent. Raise it if the server places blocks facing the wrong way.
Sends your real look direction back right after the click.
Skips a block when no click can give it the schematic orientation. When off, the block is placed anyway.
litematicaplus.option.easy_place_air.tip: Allows clicks on faces you cannot see and on air. Needed for floating blocks; some anti-cheats reject such clicks.
Extra clicks after placing: repeater delay, comparator mode, lever, open trapdoors, doors and gates, double slabs, candles, note pitch.
litematicaplus.option.easy_place_interac: A click on a chest, furnace or crafter inside the schematic opens it. When off, such clicks are blocked.
litematicaplus.option.easy_place_restric: While easy place is on, a block in hand cannot be placed by hand inside a placement or within 2 blocks of it.
litematicaplus.option.easy_place_observe: An observer is placed only after the block it watches, so it does not fire.
litematicaplus.option.easy_place_ignore_: Also takes renamed items and items with stored contents. When off, only plain items are used.
litematicaplus.option.easy_place_diagnos: Shows above the hotbar why a block was not placed.
litematicaplus.option.easy_place_substit: When the exact block is missing, places another wall, gate, trapdoor or coral fan of the same kind, or a block from your substitute list.
litematicaplus.option.substitutes_add.ti: Adds the block in your main hand to the substitute list. The number is the list size.
litematicaplus.settings.substitute_rejec: Hold a block that is not in the list yet
litematicaplus.option.entity_placement.t: Item frames with their item and rotation, paintings and armor stands with armor. Aim at the marker and use.
litematicaplus.option.excavation_guard.t: While easy place is on, stops you from breaking blocks the build needs. The two rules below choose which ones.
litematicaplus.option.excavation_guard_o: Blocks outside every shown schematic cannot be broken.
litematicaplus.option.excavation_guard_c: Blocks that already match the schematic cannot be broken.
litematicaplus.option.auto_tool_switch.t: While easy place is on, takes the best tool from your inventory before a block starts breaking.
litematicaplus.option.terrain_auto_repla: Dirt, grass, coarse dirt or a path standing where the schematic wants another of them is dug out and replaced.
litematicaplus.option.break_wrong_blocks: A different block, or the right block facing the wrong way, is mined and placed again. Containers, liquids and unbreakable blocks are never touched.
litematicaplus.option.material_helper.ti: In chests, barrels and shulker boxes highlights the items the build still needs and adds a Take materials button.
litematicaplus.editor.title: Placement editor
litematicaplus.editor.coordinate_tip: Click and type the coordinate, Enter applies it. Ctrl+V pastes three numbers such as 2000 64 -350.
litematicaplus.editor.nudge_tip: Move along %s. Hold Shift for 10 steps.
litematicaplus.editor.hint: Drag with the left button to move the schematic. Wheel changes height. Arrows and PgUp/PgDn nudge it, R turns, M mirrors, T looks from above.
litematicaplus.editor.hint_top: Left drag moves the schematic, right drag moves the view, the wheel zooms. T returns to your own view.
litematicaplus.materials.export_empty: The list is empty, there is nothing to save
litematicaplus.materials.take.tip: Moves the highlighted stacks into your inventory: %1$s with needed items, %2$s shulker boxes that hold them.
litematicaplus.materials.take_none.tip: This container holds nothing the selected placement still needs.
litematicaplus.materials.take_partial: Taking %1$s stacks, %2$s more do not fit
litematicaplus.message.entity_random_pai: No painting item with this picture in the inventory, so the game picks one at random
litematicaplus.option.hud_diagnostics.ti: Two extra lines: sections drawn / ready / total, then queued, in work and rebuilt during the last second.
litematicaplus.option.render_distance.ti: How far from the camera ghost blocks are drawn, in blocks. Does not depend on loaded chunks.
litematicaplus.hud.diag_changes: Block updates inside placements, last minute: %1$s
litematicaplus.option.trust_hidden.tip: On servers with anti-xray the client receives fake blocks for everything buried inside other blocks. A wrong block that is covered on all six sides is therefore not reported. Does not apply in singleplayer.
litematicaplus.option.world_cache.tip: Where a chunk is not loaded, the schematic is compared with the blocks Voxy has stored. Needs Voxy and VoxyMap; without them such parts stay unknown and are drawn as ghosts.
litematicaplus.option.ghosts_loaded_only: Ghost blocks are drawn only where the game itself draws the terrain, so mountains and walls always cover them. When off, the schematic is also drawn beyond loaded chunks and can show through distant terrain from Voxy.
